items.title: 30.6 1H NMR se molecule ka possible structure (mumkin banawat) maloom karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 30.6 with Example 30.2 (PDF 211).

blocks.text: Kisi na-maloom compound ka structure us ke ¹H NMR spectrum ko parh kar bhi maloom kiya ja sakta hai. Is ke liye neeche di gayi ahem maloomat ko puzzle (paheli) ki tarah jora jata hai. Structure maloom karne ke liye:

items: Spectrum mein peaks ginein. Peaks ka number = protons ke environments ka number.
Har peak ki chemical shift se functional groups pehchanein (data table, Table 30.1, use karein).
Peak ke area se har peak ke hydrogen atoms ka actual (asal) number maloom karein (yani har environment mein kitne H hain).
Splitting pattern (batne ka namoona) dekh kar saath wale protons ginein: number of sub-peaks = n + 1, yani n = number of sub-peaks – 1.
Yeh sab maloomat jor kar poora molecular structure banayein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne pehle step mein 'No. of peaks = No of protons' chhapa hai. Sahi yeh hai ke peaks ka number protons ke environments (barabar protons ke sets) ka number hai, protons ka nahi; har environment ke protons peak ke area se milte hain.

blocks.title: Example 30.2
blocks.problem: Aik ester ka ¹H NMR spectrum neeche diya gaya hai. Ester ka structure maloom karein.
steps: Given (diya gaya): aik ester ka ¹H NMR spectrum (neeche).
Hal (solution) neeche table mein hai: har peak ki chemical shift, area (protons) aur splitting se us ka group pehchana gaya hai, phir groups jor kar structure banaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Example 30.2 ke ester ka 1H NMR spectrum: absorption of energy versus chemical shift, delta ppm, 6 se 0. Taqreeban 3.9 par chaar chhoti sub-peaks (2H), taqreeban 2.1 par aik lambi akeli peak (3H), taqreeban 1.3 par teen sub-peaks (3H), aur 0 par TMS ki chhoti peak.
blocks.caption: Example 30.2: aik ester ka 1H NMR spectrum (Example 30.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 2H wala quartet (3.9 ppm) O ke saath CH₂ hai, 3H singlet (taqreeban 2.1 – 2.2 ppm) C=O ke saath CH₃, aur 3H triplet (1.3 ppm) CH₂ ke saath CH₃. Spectrum mein 3.9 wali peak ke chaar sub-peaks saaf nazar aate hain (quartet).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka table 3.9 ppm wale signal ko 'doublet' aur '2-1 = 1' likhta hai. Oxygen ke saath wale CH₂ ke parosi CH₃ mein teen protons hain, is liye yeh quartet hai: 4 – 1 = 3, jaisa spectrum bhi dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethyl group (-CH₂CH₃) signals ka kaun sa pair (jora) deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Quartet (CH₂, area 2, CH₃ se bata hua) aur triplet (CH₃, area 3, CH₂ se bata hua).

items: Peaks = environments; chemical shift = group; area = H ka number; splitting = neighbouring protons (n = sub-peaks – 1).
